prompt: Користувач скаржиться, що в GitHub іноді двічі з'являється той самий review, хоча «ми все робимо в транзакції». Модуль publish: /Users/wekcook/code/dev-digest/docs/evals/onion-architecture/fixtures/publish-in-tx/server/src/modules/publish/. Знайди причину, що ще не так, і дай виправлення.

assertions.text: Flags that the GitHub postReview call is made inside the uow.run transaction (external call inside a transaction)
Explains the duplicate-review mechanism: the review can be posted while the transaction then fails/rolls back (or a pending row remains), and a retry posts again
Flags that retryPending re-posts every pending row with no check of what was already posted (no idempotency)
Proposes committing a pending row first, calling GitHub outside any transaction, then marking the row sent
Proposes making the post safe to repeat (idempotency marker in the comment, unique key, or a lookup of an existing review before posting)
Flags getPull and github() being resolved per pending row inside the retryPending loop
Does not claim the module lacks workspace scoping, a response schema or a port for GitHub (those are fine)
